video_summary.overall_goal: Add new blood pressure measurement record and view statistics
video_summary.description: User opens app showing insufficient data message, taps add button, enters measurement data (date, time, systolic, diastolic, pulse), types note, and navigates to statistics view showing data distribution charts

steps.what_screen_is_visible: Blood pressure chart view with 'Not enough data to draw a graph' message. Shows date range (Apr 24, 2026 - May 1, 2026), tabs for Systolic/Diastolic/Pulse. Three floating action buttons visible at bottom right.

Data entry form for new blood pressure record. Shows date field (2026-05-01), time field (21:19), Systolic field (value 118 visible), Diastolic field (empty), Pulse field (value 68 visible), optional Note field, and Color field. Numeric keyboard visible at bottom.
steps.system_response: Dialog opened, form displayed with pre-filled data fields
steps.visual_feedback: Form appeared with fields ready for input
steps.intent_task: Open form to add new measurement

steps.what_screen_is_visible: Same data entry form. Diastolic field now shows value 76, Pulse field shows 68. Note field contains text 'q'. Systolic field still shows 118. Keyboard still open, user typing in note field.
steps.system_response: Text being entered in note field, keyboard active
steps.visual_feedback: Keyboard open, text cursor in note field

steps.what_screen_is_visible: Data entry form. Systolic field is now EMPTY (value 118 has been cleared). Diastolic field remains 76. Pulse field remains 68. Note field contains partial text. Keyboard still visible.
steps.system_response: Systolic field cleared, other fields intact

steps.what_screen_is_visible: Statistics screen showing multiple data visualizations. Header shows 'Statistice' (possibly typo for 'Statistics'). Two main sections: 1) Value distribution chart showing red area chart with min/max values. 2) Metrics by time of day showing a polar/radial chart with concentric rings, blue outer ring and red inner sections. Date range shown: Mar 17, 2026 - Mar 24, 2026. Back arrow visible in header. Period selector shows '7 days'.
visible_ui_elements: Metrics by time of day (polar chart)
steps.system_response: Statistics view loaded with chart data
steps.intent_task: View statistical summaries of blood pressure data

overall_flow: User starts on chart view with insufficient data message
User taps add button to open new record dialog
User enters measurement data: date, time, systolic (118), diastolic (76), pulse (68)
User types note in optional field
Systolic value mysteriously clears during interaction
Screen transitions to statistics view with data charts
human_readable_step_summary: Chart view displays insufficient data message; user waiting to interact
User taps add button; form opens with pre-filled measurement fields
User enters diastolic (76) and pulse (68) values and types note in optional field
Systolic field value (118) becomes empty; form incomplete
Navigation to statistics view; displaying value distribution and time-of-day metrics charts
